Business entities and dimensions: customer, country, cohort month.

# Terms

* [Cohort Month](cohort-month.md) - Month of a customer's first order. Frozen at acquisition, so a customer belongs to exactly one cohort forever.
* [Country](country.md) - Shipping country of an order as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (DE, FR, CZ).
* [Customer](customer.md) - A person with a Folio account who placed at least one order. Identified by customer_id.
